name: @epoch/application-gateway
description: Epoch Application Gateway service (W046, ACR-005) — the client-facing facade that COMPOSES the existing authoritative Epoch kernels/services (it orchestrates; it decides NOTHING semantic): the typed operation dispatch over the frozen @epoch/client-runtime vocabulary (session/context gates, tenant-safe W009 authorization propagation on every mutating call, correlation ledger, typed IdempotentReplay wrapping every mutating operation with durable records through the @epoch/persistence SPI), the authority map as a first-class artifact (every gateway operation -> the existing kernel/service that owns its semantics; the walk test fails on any unmapped operation), the session-mirror + idempotency + correlation persistence bindings (in-memory default; PostgreSQL durable when the pg 8.23.0 driver pool is bound — THIS package is the ONLY pg binding point, enforced by the W046 pg-boundary test), the digest-addressed evidence intake through @epoch/object-storage, the offline queue recovery.replay drain (every replay through the Action Gateway path with idempotency keys), and the deterministic construction/software product fixtures (J07/J08/J11 scenario scripts, byte-stable). The pglite real-engine suite (TEST-ONLY) auto-activates when @electric-sql/pglite materializes in the catalog (Tech Lead reconcile pending — see docs/product-runtime/limitations.md).
